question: Which of the following countries was hosted the 2025 NATO Summit held in June 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Netherlands**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The **2025 NATO Summit** is scheduled to be hosted by the **Netherlands**, marking an important event for NATO member nations to discuss global security, defense strategies, and future collaborations. • The selection of the **Netherlands** as the host country reflects its strategic importance and active role in NATO operations and policymaking. • The summit will bring together leaders of the 31 member states to address pressing global issues such as **cybersecurity threats**, **military alliances**, and **geopolitical tensions**. • The **Netherlands** has previously hosted NATO-related meetings, showcasing its strong commitment to collective defense and international cooperation. • This summit is expected to focus on strengthening NATO's policies regarding the **Indo-Pacific region**, defense modernization, and the incorporation of advanced technologies in military operations.
